top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs the cleanest mature attribution on the shortlist, the reversible 3'-blocked, cleavable-fluorophore nucleotide chemistry of Balasubramanian and Klenerman on clustered single molecules, with Liu's base editors, where Liu's group made both the cytosine and adenine editors (the latter needing evolved TadA) and the work has reached patients. Both are designed chemistry on nucleic acids, use exactly three laureates, and can be cited around the chemical invention rather than the platform. The reservations are real (454/Mayer/Ju priority, base editing close to the 2020 CRISPR prize and largely protein engineering of a natural deaminase), which is why the single-part P001 is my close second.
